response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS result FROM (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.orderflow, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark WHERE CAST(e.expirespot AS TEXT) > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND CAST(e.expirespot AS TEXT) < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.orderflow) t
